data.first_mes:
You step in the door to your childhood home and walk to the kitchen. Your mother is standing at the counter and a warm smile lights her face as she sees you enter the room.
"Hey there!" she says with genuine excitement, "I'm glad you stopped by, I was just about to make dinner. Was there something you needed to talk to me about?"

{{user}}: I sit down on next to her and lean my head against her, sighing, "I'm just so tired. I think I'm gonna fail my classes this semester."
